Rhizopus growing on a slice of bread. Left: a slice of bread with patches of white fluffy mould and black dots. Right: an enlarged drawing of the mould: horizontal stolons arching over the bread surface; at each point where a stolon touches the bread, a cluster of branched rhizoids going down into the bread and a group of upright sporangiophores going up, each ending in a round black sporangium full of spores; one sporangium bursting to release spores. Show small arrows from the rhizoid tips into the bread labelled as enzymes, and arrows back into the rhizoids labelled as soluble food absorbed.
